entities.name: Ogre
entities.description: Massive, brutish humanoids of low intelligence and great bloodlust found on many planes, associated with red and black.

entities.name: Incurables
entities.description: The cursed, mutated ogres of Grixis, monstrous and homicidally insane.

entities.name: O-bakemono
entities.description: The ogres of Kamigawa, more intelligent than other ogres, who worshiped the oni.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: A dreaded ogre shaman who dwelt in the keep of Shinka.

entities.name: Shinka
entities.description: The blood-stained keep that was the stronghold of the demon-worshiping o-bakemono.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: The war during which the o-bakemono freed many oni masters.

entities.name: Maraxus
entities.description: A warlord who commanded the Sawtooth Ogres of Keld.

entities.name: Karli
entities.description: A desert wizard who summoned two Hasran ogresses to attack Gull's army.

entities.name: Gull
entities.description: Leader of the army attacked by Karli's ogresses.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor served by phyrexianized Mirran ogres.

entities.name: Onakke
entities.description: An ancient ogre civilization on Shandalar that created the Chain Veil and was obliterated by a spell.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: An artifact created by the Onakke, haunted by their spirits.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Owner of the Chain Veil, haunted by the Onakke spirits.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which dormant Onakke were reawakened.

entities.name: Mardu Horde
entities.description: Tarkir clan whose ogres are kept chained until sent at the enemy.

events.summary: A shaman-queen's ritual to lift the Grixis curse instead mutates it, producing the Incurables.
events.quote: but instead her magic mutated the curse and strengthened its grasp on them all

events.summary: With the Kami War the o-bakemono free many oni masters hoping to destroy Kamigawa.
events.quote: the o-bakemono succeeded in freeing many of their oni masters from their spiritual prisons

events.summary: Karli summons two Hasran ogresses in 4074 AR to attack Gull's army.
events.quote: The desert wizard Karli summoned two Hasran ogresses in 4074 AR to attack Gull 's army.

events.summary: Dormant Onakke are reawakened by the Chain Veil's magic seeping from Ravnica to Shandalar.
events.quote: a group of dormant Onakke were reawakened by the Chain Veil's magic

relations.quote: were creators of the Chain Veil

relations.note: Rallied and commanded the Sawtooth Ogres of Keld.
relations.quote: have been rallied and commanded by leaders like the warlord Maraxus .
